title: KNH Directs Patients to Alternative Entrances During Trauma Centre Upgrade
desc: KNH has closed the front section of its International Trauma Centre for renovation, directing patients to alternative access points.
content:
Kenyatta National Hospital (KNH) has temporarily closed the front section of its International Trauma Centre for renovation works expected to last approximately 120 days.

The closure took effect at 5:00 PM on Monday, November 23, 2026, according to a public notice issued by the hospital and signed by Acting Chief Executive Officer Dr Joel Lessan.

The hospital said the renovation forms part of its infrastructure improvement programme and is intended to create a safer, more functional and efficient environment for patients, healthcare workers and other users.

Emergency Services to Continue

Despite the temporary closure, KNH has assured patients that emergency and trauma care services will remain available throughout the renovation period.

Patients requiring these services will be directed to designated alternative access points within the hospital.

The hospital has advised patients, visitors and emergency service providers to follow directional signs around the affected section and seek assistance from staff stationed nearby. The staff will guide them to the appropriate service points.

KNH said arrangements had been made to minimise disruption and maintain continuity of emergency and trauma care while the improvement works are underway.

Public Asked to Observe New Access Arrangements

The temporary change is particularly important for people seeking urgent medical attention, as well as families accompanying patients and emergency responders who regularly access the facility.

Members of the public visiting the hospital should therefore avoid assuming that the usual front entrance to the affected section remains accessible. Following the hospital's directions and seeking guidance from staff will help them reach the appropriate service areas.

KNH apologised for the short notice and any inconvenience caused, appealing for patience, understanding and cooperation from patients, visitors and other stakeholders during the renovation period.

The hospital said the improvements are expected to enhance the functionality of the International Trauma Centre and support the delivery of specialised emergency and trauma care.

The 120-day period is an estimated renovation duration stated by the hospital; KNH has not provided a specific completion date in the announcement.
